text: In this weak-to-strong generalization setup, a qwen2.5-3b student was fine-tuned on labels from a gpt2-small supervisor, with the student's fine-tune restricted to a low-rank adapter of rank 4. The weak supervisor reached 0.46 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling was 0.62, while the student trained on weak labels achieved a transfer accuracy of 0.54 with a standard error of 0.01. The resulting performance gap recovered was 0.53 with a standard error of 0.03, compared with a baseline PGR of 0.33. An important caveat is that these numbers come from num_seeds = 1, so the reported standard errors rest on a single run and give no information about seed-to-seed variability; the apparent separation from the baseline should therefore be treated as provisional rather than established. Replication across additional seeds, and ideally across other weak-strong model pairs and adapter ranks, would be needed before attributing the difference to the low-rank restriction itself.
